mechanism: Establish one original clearly adult showy performer, one clearly adult quiet rival and at least two adult witnesses in the same social geography. Let the first performer use visible preparation, effort and attention-seeking behavior to create a strong expectation. Introduce the rival without fanfare and prove competence through one continuous materially harder or more precise action, with no hidden cuts. Then map the social reversal through witness eye lines, positions and restrained reactions before holding both performers together. The reusable mechanism is expectation investment, quiet competence proof, audience-attention transfer and status reordering—not the source bodies, gym, exercises, glasses, woman, comedy gestures, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Establish two clearly adult original performers and at least two adult witnesses in one readable social space.
invariants.purpose: Makes status a group relation rather than private comparison.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without witnesses, attention cannot visibly transfer.

invariants.rule: Make the first performer invest in visible preparation, effort and attention seeking.
invariants.purpose: Builds a clear expectation to reverse.
invariants.ablation_failure: A brief ordinary action gives the reversal no weight.

invariants.rule: Let the quiet rival complete one harder or more precise action continuously without fanfare.
invariants.ablation_failure: Hidden cuts or cheering before completion weaken credibility.

invariants.rule: Show witness eye lines and positions move from the first performer to the rival.
invariants.ablation_failure: Reaction close-ups without spatial mapping are ambiguous.

invariants.rule: End with both adults and witnesses held in the reordered arrangement.
invariants.ablation_failure: Cutting immediately after the skill becomes only a stunt highlight.

slots.name: sound_family
